name: 20_checklist_cowrite
task: Co-write a bulleted checklist by voice: echoecho dispatches a worker to create a markdown checklist in the live workspace, extends it on request (the co-writing loop), and reads it back — the flagship 'write a doc with you' feature, plus the viewer's workspace-docs surface.
turns: let's make a packing checklist together. create a doc called packing checklist with bullet points for tent, sleeping bag, and water
now add sunscreen to the checklist
read me the checklist so far
success_criteria: echoecho dispatches a background task instead of refusing or stalling
a markdown file with at least 4 bullet lines lands in the workspace
the second request updates the same checklist (sunscreen appears)
the finished doc is served by the live viewer
task completion is woven back into the conversation as an injection
red_flags: claims it cannot write or save documents
says the checklist was written before the task's done line
creates a new file instead of extending the checklist
